name: users-customers-import-export-for-wp-woocommerce

wt_iew_maximum_execution_time.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:124-133 and helpers/class-wt-security-helper.php:72-74 store an integer; the plugin bootstrap passes it to set_time_limit (main file:93-97). Nonnumeric text can fatal. Native Save admits signed integers, so no unproven range is imposed.

wt_iew_enable_import_log.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:135-145: authored logging toggle; generated logs and imported records remain runtime.

wt_iew_default_import_method.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:147-156: default wizard method; native source quick and target template were Saved and reopened.

wt_iew_default_import_batch.note: admin/modules/import/import.php:155-163 declares min 1; import.php:991-1018 passes this default to class-csvreader.php:195-250. Zero misses the reader break after row_count increments and consumes the remaining file without batching.

wt_iew_default_export_method.note: admin/modules/export/export.php:132-145: default export wizard method; source and target native Saves diverged.

wt_iew_default_export_batch.note: admin/modules/export/export.php:155-164 declares min 1. export.php:631-645 and 917-922 preserve a zero default, so offset + batch_count at 702 cannot progress through a nonempty export. No unproven maximum is imposed.

wt_iew_enable_history_auto_delete.note: admin/modules/history/history.php:242-253: authored retention toggle. Applying configuration must not replay after_advanced_setting_update or purge operational history.

wt_iew_auto_delete_history_count.note: admin/modules/history/history.php:257-272: authored history retention limit, not a history row ID.

wt_iew_include_bom.note: admin/modules/export/export.php:145-153 declares default integer 1; native Save stores checked string 1 and unchecked integer 0. Preserve these exact scalar spellings instead of coercing them.

wt_iew_advanced_settings.note: Shared settings container: only these nine native user-importer controls are owned. Other module keys remain target-local and must survive partial Apply.

wt_iew_admin_modules.note: admin/class-wt-import-export-for-woo-admin.php:425-448: active module initialization flags, not portable settings.

notes: Experimental 2.7.5 settings and export-user template capsule. Existing settings evidence remains applicable; native template product qualification is tracked separately.

admin/modules/export/classes/class-export-ajax.php:391-400 uses the saved selected_template only for history preselection. Normal reopen selects the requested row ID; export/assets/js/main.js:395 rebuilds this cursor from the current wizard selection. Shared record_fields retains method_export and mapping_enabled_fields; the saved cursor is regenerated UI state.

Saved mapping_fields contains field-code to [label,integer-enabled] definitions; mapping_selected_fields supplies backend CSV headers. Exact field-label declarations preserve these maps without a column-wide privacy exception. Selected users use strict login bindings and native string IDs.

Import templates still need target-local CSV input qualification. Generated exports/logs, imported users, customer records and operational history remain local. Template deletion and lifecycle/combination qualification remain pending.

The native settings Save invokes wt_iew_after_advanced_setting_update_basic, whose history listener can delete files and records. WPrism materializes configuration without replaying this operational action.

wt_iew_action_history.note: Completed and in-progress import/export jobs, counters and file names stay local. Native history retention owns their deletion.

wt_iew_mapping_template.note: Native do_save_template checks (template_type,item_type,name) and stores JSON in data. Only export-user rows are owned; import and other modules remain outside this declaration.
